notes.title: Update notes for Jun 16
notes.content: Minor updates for Live View panel with better component padding.

notes.title: Update notes for Jun 15
notes.content: With this minor update the previous Live View and Feedback tabs have been combined into a single Testing tab. The Live View now has full screen overlay that centers the camera view, and provides some controls for hiding and shows the buttons panel.

notes.title: Added Linux Support
notes.content:
This update includes:

[list]
[*] Linux support
[*] Upgrading UI framework plugin to address minor bugs and few performance enhancements
[/list]

notes.title: Update for May 28
notes.content:
Minor update:
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for May 26

notes.content:
[list]

notes.title: Minor update for March 20
notes.content: This update only includes the latest device firmware.

notes.title: Release notes for March 19
notes.content:
A small update with a few goodies.

[list]
[*] Calibration screen mimics the LED guidance system
[*] LiveView also has color changing LEDs similar to the calibration screen
[*] Fixed the use of the ESC key in modals like calibration screen
[*] Contains the latest firmware
[/list]

notes.title: Minor updates for March 6
notes.content:
1. Removing ability to switch from full screen to windowed mode.
2. Adding new setting to reassign button used for accessing the system menu.

IMPORTANT:  You won't be able to switch between window mode and full screen after you install this update. If you are not in full screen mode and can clearly see the window title bar, we recommend that you switch to full screen by pressing Alt-Enter. Do this before running this update.
